# Size is not severity

`customer_support.heu.ticket_triage.size_is_not_severity` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> Do not raise priority because the account is large. Raise it because the account is entitled, or because the fault is spreading.


## The heuristic

**Do not raise priority because the account is large. Raise it because the account is entitled, or because the fault is spreading.**


_Why:_ Revenue-weighted triage feels commercially obvious and quietly converts the support queue into an account-management queue. The predictable second-order effect is that customers without commercial leverage learn that shouting is the only lever they have.
